description: Index your files and search them. Parsers for PDF, Office, images, spreadsheets, audio, video and archives feed tasks that extract, chunk, embed and lexically index text, OCR images, transcribe audio and textualize tables; then retrieve with lexical, semantic and hybrid search. A large download — it brings PyMuPDF, pandas, Pillow, librosa and the embedding/Whisper models.
name: Knowledge Base
